scientific_assessment.identity: Real count/TPM are paired representations, not experiments. Nuisance centering is an empirical fingerprint, not exact recovery of effective lengths; each exact identity is validated on disjoint real genes.
scientific_assessment.mixtures: Technical linear combinations of full-column normalized source TPM plus small synthetic perturbation. Coefficients are representation fractions, not cells/RNA mass; unsupported three-source queries retain best-pair diagnostics without a two-source biological claim.
scientific_assessment.finite_fixture_identifiability: Independent source-based prior review confirms120/120 mappings, all24 categories/accepted supports; validation minimum correlation0.949414690856, margin0.006820138255; accepted residuals<0.0011, unsupported>0.032. These measurements are finite-instance evidence, not out-of-study performance.
scientific_assessment.n3: No independent-group treatment effect or causal claim is inferred here. Three source replicates do not establish independent experiments; exact same-library provenance is a technical objective.
scientific_assessment.feature_holdout: Separate gene sets share samples and coexpression. All-source-column eligibility is frozen before query labels; it is not independent biological validation, a p-value guarantee or out-of-study generalization.
reasoning_required: Align versioned Ensembl IDs and preserve fractional source counts.
Remove arbitrary composition scales and avoid low-expression floor artifacts.
Compute nuisance-adjusted across-gene fingerprints and a bijection, with honest split scores/margins.
Fit sparse mixtures on the linear TPM representation and compute actual discovery/validation residuals.
Reject unsupported models, preserve diagnostic supports and avoid causal/cell-fraction assertions.
likely_failure_points: Raw abundant-gene correlation or condition-average identity
Forcing every query into one/two sources
Interpreting feature holdout as biological replication or weights as cells
Conditional accession-seed replay shortcut if private RNG conventions are guessed
